children: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is expected to award a consultancy contract covering the design, construction supervision and operational support of water treatment plants and associated works in Dubai in the fourth quarter of 2026, a source aware of the details said.
The tender was issued on 19 May 2026, with bids submitted on 11 August 2026.
The DFM-listed utility had received 10 bids for the contract.
“The consultancy contract is expected to be awarded in December 2026,” the source told Zawya Projects, adding that the completion is scheduled for the fourth quarter of 2028.

By the end of 2030, DEWA plans to have a total desalinated water production capacity of 735 million imperial gallons per day (MIGD) with 308 MIGD produced using seawater reverse osmosis technology powered by renewable energy, according to the quarterly financial results statement issued by the company last month.
(Reporting by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)
